card.name: Points before 'a class/effect called'
card.fires_on: Words or punctuation right before an appositive that names or classifies something, such as 'belong to a class of', ', an effect called', or '— a process called'. The next word is likely 'a' or 'an'.

modes.label: Class membership
modes.description: Verb or noun just before 'a class of' or 'a member of' when a drug is classified.

card.plain: It fires where the text is about to say 'a kind of' or 'a process called', naming or classifying something.
